title: Umugenzi Wahindukiriye
intro: Ugiye kuvumbura inkuru y'umuntu wabayeho mu gicucu cy'ubuhanuzi ariko agahitamo inzira ijyana mu irimbuka. Uyu muntu yasangiye inzu n'umwe mu ntumwa zatoranijwe na Allah ariko atsindwa ikizamini cy'ukwizera. Ni nde uyu mugenzi watakaye?
clues: Nabanye n'abantu banze umuhamagaro wo gukiranuka, kandi sinabarwanyije.
Nari narashakanye n'umuhanuzi wa Allah, ariko ntabwo nari mbyemera.
Ubwo intumwa zazaga iwanjye zizanye umuburo, sinabemeye.
Uwo twashakanye yategetswe kuva muri uwo mujyi hamwe n'abizera, kandi ntabwo nari muri bo.
Igihano cyamanukiye ku bwoko bwanjye, nanjye ndarimbukana nabwo.
Muri Korowani havugwamo urugero rw'ubuhakanyi, hamwe n'umugore wa Nuh, muri Surah At-Tahrim.

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
